sloka: आर्यस्याज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य विसृज्य जनकात्मजाम् ।गङ्गातीरे यथोद्दिष्टे वाल्मीकेराश्रमे शुचौ ।। ७.५२.८ ॥
transliteration: āryasyājñāṁ puraskṛtya visṛjya janakātmajām ।gaṅgātīre yathoddiṣṭe vālmīkerāśrame śucau ।। 7.52.8 ॥

translations.english: Having followed your command, I left Janaka's daughter on the pure bank of the Ganga, in Valmiki's hermitage as instructed.
